title: Legs on Fire
description: Legs on fire with 1.5 squats and forward lunges, completed by a core resistance block

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: 1.5 squats
exercises.instructions: Lower, rise halfway, lower again, then rise fully

exercises.name: Forward lunges
exercises.instructions: Big step forward, back knee grazes the floor

exercises.name: Good morning
exercises.instructions: Hands behind the head, hinge forward keeping the back straight

exercises.name: Marching glute bridge
exercises.instructions: In a bridge, alternate lifting one leg then the other like marching

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, arms and legs up, extend opposite arm and leg alternating

exercises.name: V-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift arms and legs together to touch the feet

exercises.name: Shoulder tap plank
exercises.instructions: In a high plank, tap the opposite shoulder alternating

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
